residual: max(raw_prediction,0)-actual; sign convention does not change I
alignment: At each forecast origin and horizon, compare585 ZIP residuals; never flatten region-days or sum across regions
spatial_weights: Symmetric union of8 nearest neighbors using haversine distances between2021 Gazetteer internal points; zero diagonal, row-standardized after symmetrizing. Weights after normalization are not necessarily symmetric.
distance: Great-circle km; internal points, not polygon centroid or adjacency
mapping: Exact postal ZIP identifier to ZCTA GEOID remains unvalidated; diagnostic conditional on this mapping
null: Exchangeability of residual labels across regions conditional on fitted predictions; heteroskedastic count residuals may violate it. Exploratory diagnostic, not a formal spatial-regression specification test.
multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across all valid dates x horizons in this stage; overlapping dates/spatial dependence mean FDR control is not guaranteed. No pooled overall significance claim.
constant_residual_policy: Undefined I and p, retained as NA
parameter_fitting: None. No prediction or feature changes.
inference: Positive I indicates similar signed residuals cluster under selected W. Nonsignificance is not evidence that all spatial patterns are explained.
